Test scenario: Attempt to access a protected function without signing in.
Attempt to modify KPI data without the required permission.
Create or edit a KPI with valid information.
Enter a valid actual KPI value.
Expected result: The value is stored and displayed correctly.

Test scenario: Enter an invalid value for a numeric KPI.
Expected result: The system displays a validation error.

Test scenario: Compare a numeric target of 100 with an actual value of 80.
Expected result: The system displays a difference of -20.

Test scenario: View a KPI without an annual target.
Expected result: The missing target is not treated as zero.

Test scenario: Filter KPIs by year and strategic direction.
Generate a report for a selected year.
Expected result: The report contains the corresponding KPI results.
The modification is recorded in change history, if implemented.

Test scenario: Enter a percentage outside the accepted range for a percentage-type KPI.
Expected result: The value is rejected with an explanatory message.

Test scenario: Enter and retrieve a milestone/status result.
Expected result: The status is shown without a numeric success ratio.

Test scenario: Open a KPI without an actual result.
Expected result: The result is labeled missing rather than represented as zero.

Test scenario: Inspect a KPI with an assigned department.
Expected result: The appropriate responsible unit is displayed.
